note: Written by the evening check (Claude). Own words, verified facts only, each with its source. Display only: no entry or exit rule reads this file.

market.summary: Indian markets were shut today for Dussehra, so no Indian prices moved and every stop and level is unchanged from Monday's close. Abroad the tone was firmer: US stocks rose by mid-morning as chip stocks bounced, while Brent spiked to a five-month high on Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure before easing. Wednesday 21 Oct is the next session and the Jio Platforms IPO (Rs 30,213 Cr) opens the same day. For the holdings this is a slightly better backdrop than Monday's sell-off, but FIIs are still selling and the engine's NIFTY 500 check stays RISK-OFF.

points.text: NSE and BSE closed on Tuesday 20 Oct (Dussehra); trading resumes Wednesday 21 Oct.
US mid-morning 20 Oct: Dow +0.9% (52,436), S&P 500 +0.44% (7,724), Nasdaq +0.25%, Russell 2000 +0.9%; tech opened lower and turned positive as chip stocks bounced.
Brent touched a five-month high after Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure, then slipped to about $109; the US 10-year yield was 5.11%.

US housing data was weak (September pending home sales -7.3% to a record-low index of 66.0; housing starts 1.221 million vs 1.305 million expected); BofA still expects a Fed hike in October, markets price about 20%.
Jio Platforms IPO: 21-23 Oct, price band Rs 1,065-1,119, Rs 30,213 Cr fresh issue, listing expected 28 Oct.
Last NSE provisional flows (19 Oct): FIIs sold about Rs 1,149 Cr, DIIs bought about Rs 3,201 Cr; FIIs sold about Rs 8,431 Cr over 5 sessions.

market.watch: Wednesday's open: whether the firmer US tone and an oil pull-back hold, and whether FIIs keep selling; the Jio IPO may draw liquidity from the secondary market for three days.

HCLTECH.summary: No new filing or company news; the market was shut, so the trade stays at Rs 1,379.90, +0.45R, stop 1,225.82. The global backdrop for Indian IT kept improving: US IT services stocks extended their rally, which started with Accenture's 14 Oct investor-day targets and money rotating out of AI and chip stocks into services. This supports the post-result drift but is sector mood, not new HCLTECH information.

points.text: Cognizant rose 12% between 9 and 16 Oct with no news of its own; Accenture's investor day (14 Oct) targeted mid-single-digit revenue growth in FY27-28 and 10-30 bp margin expansion a year; EPAM +6.3% on 15 Oct.
During US trading today Accenture was about +2.1%, Cognizant +1.8%, Infosys ADR +2.4% and Wipro ADR +2.3% (engine's Yahoo snapshot at about 11:00 New York time).
Cognizant reports its September-quarter results on Thursday 29 Oct, the next read on US client demand.
Last filing is the 16 Oct RSU grant (routine); nothing new since.

HCLTECH.watch: A close at or above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; Cognizant results on 29 Oct.
